fdbd4b23-d3ad-43f6-bfff-dbb61a9aa3c5.title: Open OWTB2B dev app login screen
fdbd4b23-d3ad-43f6-bfff-dbb61a9aa3c5.description: Opens the OWTB2B dev app (base path /workspace-owtb2b/). Use this as the first step before checking the sign-in / register screen.

8f89ca70-328a-4f41-9f14-e5a8c669ab20.title: Easy Apply — paced worker with known screening answers
8f89ca70-328a-4f41-9f14-e5a8c669ab20.description: Generic LinkedIn Easy Apply walker with human pacing. Resolves the question text from the DOM (works on both the standard modal and 12-page Lever/Workday style forms), fills only the confirmed screening answers, treats Bedrock/Vertex/Azure-OpenAI/Kafka-ownership claims as blockers and returns the exact question instead of guessing.

9949760c-0262-474c-bc6b-ac8e54e53b3b.title: Easy Apply — walk to Review, NEVER submit
9949760c-0262-474c-bc6b-ac8e54e53b3b.description: Opens Easy Apply on the job page in front of you, fills contact/resume/screening pages with the confirmed answers and STOPS at the Review page. It never clicks Submit: the human presses it. Call it on a /jobs/view/<id>/ tab.

3eb16983-9ce2-4ad9-bb42-37c0a808ccc5.title: Probe native Easy Apply (batch pre-filter)
3eb16983-9ce2-4ad9-bb42-37c0a808ccc5.description: Pre-filter a list of LinkedIn job ids for a REAL native Easy Apply before opening any of them. Fetch each /jobs/view/<id>/ page (paced 700ms, same session, one pass) and test for a rendered `<button aria-label="Easy Apply to this job">`. The offsite variant only exists as an escaped JS config string, never as a button. Validated 2026-11-21 with two negative controls (4485224480, 4490444040 -> NO) and 28 true positives. Use BEFORE driving applications so Lever/Workable postings are dropped instead of costing 4-6 tool calls each.
